svg.aria-label: A document workshop. A sealed original archive is separate from source-data cards and a mapping comb. A versioned template plate feeds a generation press. Its output is a new derived PDF with provenance, inspected before any later approval and dispatch. The original bytes are never overwritten.
svg.desc: A document workshop. A sealed original archive is separate from source-data cards and a mapping comb. A versioned template plate feeds a generation press. Its output is a new derived PDF with provenance, inspected before any later approval and dispatch. The original bytes are never overwritten. The small cobalt envelope marks an illustrative document, not a live operation.
